0022600106.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (0-2, 13th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Central) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (2-0, first in the Atlantic and second in the East), who are riding a two-game win streak. The Bucks lost all four meetings with Philadelphia in the 2025-26 season series, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season. The 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain), while Dean Wade (ankle sprain) and LeBron James (back) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions.
